photos.why: A full house at Sentry faces the speaker and the screen, with downtown's towers lit through the windows behind.
Wall-to-wall rows of builders watching the demos, the room packed to the brick at the back.
A long hall filled with rows facing the talk, the welcome slide on both screens.
Every table of the hackathon full, laptops open, the whole floor turned to the stage.
Rows of faces across the whole floor, laughing at the talk.
A crowd filling Vercel's floor, facing the speaker.
